assumptions: The column shape, well order and phosphorylation values are those of IDT's published plate upload template.
Each product's length range is the one its manufacturability profile carries, read from IDT's own pages.
limits: IDT only: Twist's order template is behind an account and is not written.
96-well plates only, the one layout the template lists.
bio.jane/contract.question: What sheet does IDT's gene-fragment plate upload take for these fragments, and which of them can the product not be ordered as?

description: Write the sheet IDT's gene-fragment PLATE upload takes for one or more designed fragments: one worksheet per 96-well plate, wells in the template's own order, and the template's four columns (well, name, sequence, 5' phosphorylation). A fragment outside the product's length range, unnamed, or carrying a non-IUPAC base is refused by name; one outside the product's published GC or homopolymer limits is kept and named, because a vendor publishes what it supports, not what it rejects. It WRITES A FILE and sends nothing: no account, no key, no network call.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

feature.description: order a named feature of the open record instead of the whole record: the insert rather than the vector it sits in. Advanced.

names.description: a name per fragment, in the same order. Required with `sequences`: a well is ordered by name, so an unnamed fragment is refused rather than numbered.

phosphorylate.description: ask for 5' phosphorylation on every fragment. IDT offers it for blunt cloning only.

plate_name.description: the plate's name, which becomes the worksheet's name. Several plates get ' (2)', ' (3)' appended.

product.description: which IDT fragment product to order the fragments as. It sets the length range a fragment must fall in, and eBlocks take a per-plate minimum. Values: idt-gblocks (gBlocks Gene Fragments (125–3,000 bp)), idt-eblocks (eBlocks Gene Fragments (300–1,500 bp)).

sequences.description: the fragments to order, 5'→3'. Leave unset to order the open record, or the current selection or named `feature` of it, under the record's name.

name: design_gene_fragment_order

plateCount.description: how many plates the fragments needed

plateMinimum.description: set when the product takes a minimum per plate and a plate falls under it; empty otherwise

profile.description: the vendor profile the length range came from, with its page and retrieval date

reading.description: what the order is, generated from the laid-out plates

refused.description: every fragment left OUT, with the reason

rows.description: every plate as header-first rows in the template's column shape, keyed by worksheet name: what the .xlsx holds

sheets.description: one entry per PLATE: its worksheet name and every laid-out well, each with the published limits it sits outside
